title: Pocketwire Savings Vault Pass-Through Deposit Insurance Disclosure
content:
**Disclosure.** The combined Pocketwire Savings Vault balance, together with the balance of the customer's Pocketwire Personal Account ledger, is insured up to the FDIC pass-through limit per program bank, across the number of program banks of the customer's tier.

## Figures by tier

| | Pocketwire Vault Essential | Pocketwire Vault Select | Pocketwire Vault Preferred | Pocketwire Vault Premier | Pocketwire Vault Reserve | Pocketwire Vault Private |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FDIC pass-through limit per program bank | $250000.00 | $250000.00 | $250000.00 | $250000.00 | $250000.00 | $250000.00 |
| Program banks the combined vault balance is spread over | 1 | 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 20 |

## Points of reading

- **What is counted.** The insured amount is measured on the customer's combined deposits: the balances of the customer's vaults taken together, plus the personal ledger balance.
- **Per program bank.** The limit of $250000.00 is the insurance limit at each program bank. The combined vault balance is spread over the tier's number of program banks for pass-through insurance: 1 bank on Pocketwire Vault Essential and Select, 2 on Preferred, 4 on Premier, 8 on Reserve and 20 on Private.
- **Same limit on every tier.** The per-bank limit does not vary by tier; what varies is the number of program banks.
